subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require a default confirmation, and should OpenClaw add any opt-out/config surface for that behavior?
rationale: The code change is straightforward, but it changes documented command semantics and possibly public config; repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding config or changing command UX across clients.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and do not add config unless follow-up evidence proves the need.

options.title: Add configurable confirmation
options.body: Add the confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting the added config and migration/docs burden.

options.title: Preserve explicit command behavior
options.body: Keep typed commands immediate and limit confirmation to visible UI buttons or future non-command affordances.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and do not add config unless follow-up evidence proves the need.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current Control UI confirmation and slash-command behavior history.
